plan.title: Rejected Bids Close on Awarded Event

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event on the RFQ Responses tab.
Record the expected single vendor response before opening Rejected Bids.
Open the RFQ Settings menu item for Rejected Bids.
Close the Rejected Bids window as required by the case.
Verify that the Rejected Bids window is no longer open.
Verify that the awarded state remains visible after closing the window.
Verify that the response count and vendor bid view remain unchanged.
Ensure closing the window did not cause an error or rendering issue.
